name: Sample Fairford Field
tagline: A simple, friendly field on the edge of the Cotswolds, with room for groups and campervans.
about: This is a sample page. It shows campsite owners what their listing on the guide will look like once they send their details over.
Your own words go here: what the site is like, how long you have been running it, what makes it a good base for the Air Tattoo, and anything visitors always ask about.

owner.name: The site owner
owner.quote: A line or two from you, in your own words, sits here.

facilities.food-van: Burger van on Friday and Saturday evening

toShow.driveMins: About 1 hour to MOD Boscombe Down

goodToKnow: Please keep it down from 23:00 to 07:00.
Children welcome. There is a small play area by the farm gate.
Groups of up to 4 pitches can be booked together. Bigger groups, please ask.
Level grass, with an accessible toilet near the entrance. No accessible shower yet.
You can see the arrivals on Wednesday and Thursday from the top of the field.

booking.cancellation: Full refund up to 30 days before arrival
booking.offer: Any offer for guide readers goes here.
